unlisted_reads_as: null: a block the game does not have, or a value its properties do not take; a property a state leaves out reads as its block's default
why: a wall reads the block above it on every update: the side strips and the post center that block's collision underside covers, and whether it is in wall_post_override. Both twins carry this table, generated by tools/generate_wall_cover.py from the game's own shapes
